To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the novel CS-PEG decorated PLGANP nanoformulation is a potential candidate for the delivery of anticancer drugs to hepatocellular carcinoma cells.
we have successfully developed and characterized a CS-PEG coated PLGA nanosystem that can be used as a delivery vehicle for bioactive compounds.
we successfully synthesized a novel CS-PEG decorated PLGAs nano-prototyped for the delivery of bioactive compound.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel drug carriers for the targeted delivery of bioactive molecules.
the development of new and efficient methods for the synthesis of 2,4,6-triarylpyrylium perchlorate salts.

the synthesis and characterization of a new class of poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) modified poly(lactic acid-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) nano-prototypes (CS-PEG-PLGA) for delivery of bio-active compounds (BC) and their application in cancer therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of the term “apoptotic” is not appropriate for the description of the cell death observed in the present study.
the study of the role of the CS-PEG in the context of the CS-PE is not a significant problem.
the use of a nano-prototype as a carrier of bioactive compounds is a novel and efficient approach to induce apoptosis in HepG 2 cell line.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a novel approach for the synthesis of CS-PEG-PLGA nano-prototypes.
we have designed and developed a nano-prototypical drug delivery system for induction of apoptosis.
we have successfully designed, synthesized, and characterized a novel CS-PEG decorated PLGAs nanocarriers for delivery of bioactives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of PEGylated PLGA nanoparticles for the delivery of the bioactive compounds is a promising tool for the treatment of cancer.
the addition of PEGylated nanoparticles to the culture medium of the cells can significantly increase the efficiency of the drug in killing the cancer cells.
the use of a combination of different drugs can be an effective approach in the treatment of cancer, especially if these drugs are delivered to the tumor site.
